minutes_text:
MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  City Council, Community Development Agency,
  Community Development Financing Authority,
  Public Improvement Corporation,
  and Library Board of Trustees*

  January 19, 2009

A Regular Meeting of the City Council, the Community Development Agency, the Community
Development Financing Authority, the Public Improvement Corporation, and the Library Board
of Trustees of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor Ury at 5:01
p.m., on January 19, 2009 at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on January 14, 2009, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also
posted at the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and the
Norman P. Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

*All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title "Council Member."

Present:  Council Member Kelley
  Council Member Ledesma
  Council Member Schlicht (arrived at 5:03 p.m.)
  Mayor Pro Tem MacLean
  Mayor Ury

Absent:  None

Staff Present:  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  Irwin Bornstein, Assistant City Manager/Director of Admin. Services
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney (arrived at 5:03 p.m.)
  Karen Hamman, City Clerk

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Kelley

INVOCATION: Council Member Ledesma

RECESS

  At the hour of 5:03 p.m., Mayor Ury declared a recess. The City Council reconvened at
  6:00 p.m. with all five City Council Members present.

City Council Minutes  1  January 19, 2009
 PRESENTATIONS

P1.  Recognize Battalion Chief Steve Whitaker , Upon his Retirement From the Orange
  County Fire Authority

  Council Member Kelley presented the Certificate of Appreciation to Chief Whitaker.

P2.  Recognize Mission Viejo’s Community Recycling Program Award Winner

  Michelle Clark, Waste Management of Orange County, presented the Recycling Program
  Award to residents Paul and Doris Swanson.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

  Martha Underwood, M.V.: stated that she is trying to think of the appropriate words to
  thank the City for the Rose Parade float. The Community came together with this event
  and anyone who volunteered is hoping the City will enter a float year after year.

  Rusty Underwood, M.V.: announced that participating in the decorating of the Rose
  Parade float was his 15 minutes of fame and he is very proud to have had the opportunity.

  Helen Workun, M.V.: thanked the Orange County Register for conducting the on-line
  survey regarding the Rose Parade float and she thanked the residents who responded to it.
  The survey showed that overwhelmingly, the residents approved of the city’s decision to
  have a float in the parade.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Items 3, 4, 5, and 13 were removed from the Consent Calendar for separate discussion.

Motion made by Council Member Ledesma, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem MacLean, to approve
the Consent Calendar as described below.

On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

AYES:  Kelley, Ledesma, MacLean, Schlicht, and Ury
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None

1.  Waive Reading of Ordinances and Resolutions

City Council Minutes  2  January 19, 2009
   Approved the reading by title of all ordinances and resolutions and declared that said
  titles which appear on the public agenda shall be determined to have been read by title
  and further reading waived.

2.  City Council Minutes

  Approved the Minutes for the Regular City Council Meeting of January 5, 2009, as
  presented.

6.  City Treasurer's Monthly Report for November 2008

  Received and filed.

7.  Community Development Agency Treasurer's Monthly Report for November 2008

  Received and filed.

8.  Mission Viejo Community Development Financing Authority (MVCDFA)
  Treasurer's Monthly Report for November 2008

  Received and filed.

9.  Rate Adjustment for Solid Waste Delivered to Southeast Resource Recovery
  Facility

  Adopted Resolution 09-04 Approving the Proposed Rate Adjustment for Solid Waste
  Delivered to Southeast Resource Recovery Facility (Waste-to-Energy) for Disposal (from
  $61.83 to $67.52) Effective February 1, 2009.

10.  Animal Shelter Shade Structure (CIP 301) -- Notice of Completion of Galvanized
  Metal Doors, Electric Doors, Electric Door Openers, and Hood Covers (Shroud) for
  Outdoor Dog Kennels at Animal Services Center

  (1) Authorized the City Clerk to record Notice of Completion with the County of Orange
  and to release the faithful performance and payment bonds one year and 35 days
  respectively after the date of recordation of the Notice of Completion contingent upon no
  claims or liens being filed with or by the City; and (2) authorized the payment of the final
  retention of $ 11,240.10, 35 days after the date of recordation of the Notice of
  Completion.

11.  Site Fencing Repairs/Replacement (CIP 304) -- Notice of Completion

City Council Minutes  3  January 19, 2009
   (1) Authorized the City Clerk to record Notice of Completion with the County of Orange
  and to release the faithful performance and payment bonds one year and 35 days
  respectively after the date of recordation of the Notice of Completion contingent upon no
  claims or liens being filed with or by the City; and (2) authorized the payment of the final
  retention of $ 26,250.50, 35 days after the date of recordation of the Notice of
  Completion.

12.  Department of Homeland Security Grant Program Authorizing Agent Resolution

  Adopted Resolution 09-05 Authorizing Certain Positions to act as Agents to Execute
  Documents for Financial Assistance Provided by the Federal Department of Homeland
  Security and Sub-granted Through the State of California.

PUBLIC HEARINGS

OLD BUSINESS

  Council Member Schlicht made the following nominations:

  Planning and Transportation Commission - Andrew Quinio
  Community Services Commission - Brian Skalsky
  Investment Advisory Commission - Mark Dobrilovic

  Motion was made by Council Member Schlicht, seconded by Council Member Ledesma,

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Ledesma, MacLean, Schlicht, and Ury

  Motion was made by Council Member Schlicht, seconded by Council Member Ledesma,
  to approve the appointment of Brian Skalsky to serve on the Community Services

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

City Council Minutes  4  January 19, 2009
   AYES:  Kelley, Ledesma, MacLean, Schlicht, and Ury

13.  2009 Orange County International Triathlon in Mission Viejo

  Motion was made by Council Member Ledesma, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem MacLean,
  to approve the request submitted by Pelican Coast Events LLC to hold the 2009 Orange

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

MAYOR’S, COMMISSION, AND COMMITTEE REPORTS

15.  Orange County Fire Authority (OCFA) Report

  Received the report from Council Member Kelly on the recent OCFA Budget and
  Finance Committee Meeting.

City Council Minutes  6  January 19, 2009
 16.  Foothill/Eastern Transportation Corridor Agency Report

  Received the report from Council Member MacLean.

17.  San Joaquin Hills Transportation Corridor Agency Report

  Received the report from Council Member Ledesma.

STAFF REPORTS

  City Manager’s Report

  City Manager Wilberg assured the Council that with all of the negative financial
  information publicized in the media, he and staff are monitoring the city’s budget on a
  daily basis. Mr. Wilberg provides a Friday recap of the week’s activities and he asked the
  Council Members to contact him or Irwin Bornstein for updated information not only at
  the State level but here in the City. He further announced that any funding we might lose
  to the State we are hopping to retrieve through recovery funds.

  City Attorney's Report

COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS

18.  Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended

  The City Council Members acknowledged their event and activities calendars as
  presented in the staff report and agreed to provide any changes to the City Clerk for the
  public record.

Council Member Kelley

  Council Member Kelley congratulated Mission Viejo Deputies Brad Blakely, Mission
  Viejo Sheriff’s Department Employee of the Year, and Bobby Simmons, Trabuco Hills
  High School Resource Officer who was recently recognized by the Elks Club as Deputy
  of the Year. Council Member Kelley expressed sadness at the loss of a very special
  resident, Casta del Sol resident Martha Whitfield, and she asked Mayor Ury to adjourn
  the meeting in memory of Mrs. Whitfield.

Council Member Ledesma

  Council Member Ledesma congratulated the new Commissioners and expressed his
  appreciation for their willingness to participate.

City Council Minutes  7  January 19, 2009
 Council Member Schlicht

19.  City Council Salary Amendment

  Motion made by Council Member Schlicht, seconded by Council Member Ledesma, to
  rescind the 100% compensation increase that was adopted on October 6, 2008 by a 4-1
  vote.

  Larry Gilbert, M.V.: stated that when an individual pulls papers to run for City Council,
  they are informed what they will be paid by stipend. He asked why this wasn’t brought
  up immediately after the respective elections and stated that he supports the
  recommendation to reverse it.

  Council Member Ledesma withdrew his second, therefore the motion died for lack of a
  second.

Council Member Schlicht discussed her communication today with a resident who reported
graffiti on the La Barca hill cell site and on an Edison A-frame; she asked staff to get it cleaned
up as soon as possible. Council Member Schlicht announced that today is her 50th day in her
elected position and she dedicated her comments to her Uncle Vincent who passed away on
January 10th.

Mayor Pro Tem MacLean

  Mayor Pro Tem MacLean announced that he had the opportunity this past week to meet
  with two residents who had concerns about our budget. The meetings went very well and
  he was able to dialog with the residents and learn what projects they would like to see
  prioritized. He stated that the residents were happy with the opportunity to meet with
  him and lean more about historical expenditures and the City’s commitment to future
  facility renovations and continue police services funding. Mayor Pro Tem MacLean
  invited any resident who wishes to discuss the City’s budget, programs, or services to call
  him or Council secretary Jennifer Olch to schedule an appointment.

Mayor Ury

  Mayor Ury echoed Mayor Pro Tem MacLean's comments and invited interested residents
  to reach out to the City Council Member with emails or phone calls if they have questions
  or concerns. He noted that the Council’s responsibilities are not limited to their work at
  the Council Meetings; there are constant obligations between the meetings as well.
  Mayor Ury discussed his attendance at the Mission Viejo Elk’s “Officer Appreciation
  Day” and he thanked the Elks for their hospitality. He further discussed his upcoming
  attendance, with Mayor Pro Tem MacLean, at the League of California Cities conference

City Council Minutes  8  January 19, 2009
   in Sacramento. He looks forward to hearing updates on the state budget so we will have
  a better understanding of the issues.

ADJOURNMENT

  At the hour of 6:50 p.m., there being no further business to come before the City Council
  at this session, Mayor Ury adjourned the meeting in memory of Martha Whitfield to
  Monday, February 2, 2009, at 5:00 p.m.

__________________________________________
Karen Hamman, City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of February 2, 2009

City Council Minutes  9  January 19, 2009
